events.title: Scheduled CoreWeave Electrical Maintenance - US-EAST-04A
events.description: Details: CoreWeave will be performing electrical maintenance from Monday, August 31 at 12:00 UTC through Friday, September 4 at 21:00 UTC that will affect the UPS systems supporting one data hall in our US-EAST-04A facility. Impact: No impact to compute, storage, or network availability is expected and no customer action is required. Critical load is maintained by generator power while UPSs are unavailable. While a lineup is on maintenance bypass, that lineup operates without UPS battery ride-through, which is a temporary reduction in power redundancy. Utility power remains available throughout. We will be actively monitoring the situation during this time. We appreciate your patience and understanding. If you have any further questions or require assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out to our support team at support@coreweave.com This activity is deemed Planned Maintenance under the CoreWeave Terms of Service Maintenance Policy ( https://docs.coreweave.com/policies/terms-of-service/maintenance-policy )

events.title: Object Storage Performance Degradation in US-WEST-01A
events.description: We are investigating elevated error rates and increased latency for Object Storage in the US-WEST-01A region. Requests to this region may intermittently return HTTP 503 responses or take longer than usual to complete. Our engineering team is actively engaged and working to identify the root cause.

updates.body: We are investigating elevated error rates and increased latency for Object Storage in the US-WEST-01A region. Requests to this region may intermittently return HTTP 503 responses or take longer than usual to complete. Our engineering team is actively engaged and working to identify the root cause.
We have identified the issue and are continuing to work on a resolution at this time.

We've implemented a fix to address the object storage latency and error codes in US-WEST-01A. All services are now fully operational, and we are monitoring closely to ensure stability. If you continue to see issues, please reach out to support@coreweave.com.

We are investigating renewed elevated error rates and increased latency for object storage in US-WEST-01A. A change applied earlier today improved service for a period, but the degradation has returned and our engineering team is actively engaged and working to identify the root cause. Clients may see intermittent 503 responses.

We believe the issues affecting latency have been resolved, and the impacted service is now operational. We are closely monitoring the environment to ensure stability and will post another update if we observe any recurrence or unexpected behavior prior to resolving. If you are still seeing issues, please reach out to support@coreweave.com.
We believe the issue is resolved, and our services are now operational. If you are continuing to experience issues, please reach out to support@coreweave.com.

events.title: Degraded Grafana Metrics Performance — US-EAST
events.description: We're investigating degraded performance with metrics in US-EAST. Querying US-EAST metrics in Grafana may be slow or return intermittent errors. Metric ingestion is degraded, but no metric data is being lost, and customer workloads are not affected. We'll provide updates as we remediate.

updates.body: We're investigating degraded performance with metrics in US-EAST. Querying US-EAST metrics in Grafana may be slow or return intermittent errors. Metric ingestion is degraded, but no metric data is being lost, and customer workloads are not affected. We'll provide updates as we remediate.

We have identified the cause of the metrics degradation and are actively working on a fix. We have also taken steps to stabilize the metrics query endpoints, and we continue to monitor overall system health. We will share further updates as remediation progresses.
